name: junctionmover
description: JunctionMover - C盘目录扫描与安全迁移工具

scripts.package: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$v=(Get-Content package.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).version; Copy-Item 'src-tauri\target\release\junctionmover.exe' ('src-tauri\target\release\JunctionMover_' + $v + '_x64.exe'); Write-Host ('OK: JunctionMover_' + $v + '_x64.exe')"
